title: Concordant RNA-protein evidence and human tissue metabolomics prioritize UPP1-associated nucleotide remodeling in prostate cancer.
snippet: Prostate cancer (PCa) is characterized by molecular heterogeneity and metabolic reprogramming, but the relationships among transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolic signals remain incompletely defined. title: Integrated single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing analyses identify a myeloid state-related gene signature for molecular subtyping in stomach adenocarcinoma.
